Soft pieces

Chickpea pancakes

Csicseriborsós palacsinta

8 months+ Adjusted 25 min 4 portions

Cut into soft strips. The center of each pancake should be dry and fully cooked.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 80 g chickpea flour (not peanut)
  • 160 ml water
  • 1 small carrot (grated)
  • 1 small onion (finely chopped and cooked)
  • 40 g sweet pepper (finely chopped and cooked until soft)
  • 1/4 tsp turmeric (instead of curry powder)
  • 1 tsp olive oil (thin film in the pan)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Cook the onion and sweet pepper until soft.
  2. Mix the chickpea flour, water, and turmeric, then stir in the carrot, onion, and sweet pepper.
  3. Add no salt and no curry powder.
  4. Oil a pan lightly and cook small pancakes over moderate heat until the underside is set, then turn them.
  5. Cook until the center is fully set, then cool and cut into soft strips.

Adjusted

The usual seasoning is a salty curry powder, and an undercooked pancake stays wet in the middle. Chickpea is not peanut, so it is not listed as a peanut allergen.

Cook chickpea-flour pancakes with grated carrot, cooked onion, and sweet pepper, and season them with turmeric rather than curry powder. Cook the batter through and add no salt.
